title: CVSS score attributed to govulncheck output
code_snippet:
$ govulncheck ./...
=== Symbol Results ===
Vulnerability #1: GO-2024-0001
  Module: example.com/vmod

# Auditor's report:
# "GO-2024-0001 — CVSS 7.5 (High). Priority P1 on the CVSS threshold."
violated_rule: Never state a CVSS score sourced from govulncheck
expected_feedback: govulncheck printed no CVSS score and cannot: the Go vulnerability database does not publish severity. That 7.5 was invented or silently copied. Report CVSS as 'not retrieved', or enrich it from a named external source keyed on the CVE/GHSA alias and cite that source. Either way the priority comes from the evidence tier, not the number.
coverage_rules: Never state a CVSS score sourced from govulncheck
